paragraphs.zh: mit der Maßgabe, daß -L-R1 nicht für gegebenenfalls substituiertes CH2-O-Phenyl stehen soll, wenn R2 und R3 jeweils Chlor  und R4 und R5 jeweils Wasserstoff bedeuten.
paragraphs.en: with the proviso that -L-R1 is not to stand for optionally substituted CH2-O-phenyl when R2 and R3 are each chlorine and R4 and R5 are each hydrogen.
paragraphs.notes: Tail of the proviso that closes claim 1; it begins on the previous page. This WO publication prints no [00NN] paragraph markers anywhere, so the marker is the claim number rather than a printed marker. In the print the digits after R and L-R are superscript and the 2 in CH2 is subscript; transcribed inline here because the field is plain text. The double space between 'Chlor' and 'und' is as printed and has been kept. The identical sentence appears in the description on printed page 4 (p06). A small stray ink mark sits in the right margin about one line below 'bedeuten.'; it looks like scan speckle, not a printed character. A second speckle sits to the left of 'WO 00/21924' in the header.
Opening line of claim 2, a dependent claim that narrows the substituent definitions of claim 1. The gap between the claim number and the text is as printed.

paragraphs.notes: The R1 definition of claim 2, printed as R with a superscript 1 and transcribed inline as R1. The list runs to the foot of the page and is cut off mid-name: the last words printed are 'gegebenenfalls substituiertes N-Alkyl-N-', which continues on the following page. The list is set over 27 printed lines; the line breaks are typesetting only and have been flowed into one string. Printed wide gaps kept as double spaces after 'Aryl,', after 'Arylalkinyloxy,' and after 'Arylalkinylthio,'. In the translation German 'Alkinyl' is rendered 'alkynyl' and 'gegebenenfalls substituiertes' as 'optionally substituted'; the extra printed spaces are not reproduced in the English.
